# Golden fixtures (branch-local, DO NOT commit to main)

Generated by Phase 1 of the legibility refactor on the frozen Phase-0 stack
(JAX 0.10 / NumPyro 0.21 / ArviZ 1.2). `tests/test_golden.py` asserts every
later refactor phase reproduces these bit-for-bit. Regenerate with the smoke
config; delete in Phase 10. These prove refactors don't change numerical output.

Regenerate:

```bash
mkdir -p tests/fixtures/golden && rm -rf tests/fixtures/golden/total
sed 's|output_dir: "results"|output_dir: "tests/fixtures/golden"|' \
  configs/fertility_smoke_test.yaml > /tmp/golden.yaml
uv run scripts/run_analysis.py --config /tmp/golden.yaml
```

**Same-machine caveat:** the smoke config uses `auto_parallelism: true`, so the
chain count is chosen from the visible device count. The bit-identity gate is
only deterministic on the machine that generated the fixtures. Regenerate
locally if you switch machines/core counts.
